BRAND STORY

Born from a father’s love for his son’s eczema

ATOPALM began with one father’s search for gentle care for his son’s dry, eczema-prone skin. That care became MLE Cream: barrier moisture care for babies and families with sensitive skin.

02

Why MLE Cream is Different

①

MLE® Technology

Mimics your skin’s own barrier.

MLE® (Multi-Lamellar Emulsion) is NeoPharm’s original technology. It recreates the lamellar structure of natural skin lipids to help restore the skin barrier and keep moisture locked in.

Content DO & DON’T

DO

  • ✓Put #Gifted at the start of your caption.
  • ✓Speak from your own experience: “In our experience…,” “For my baby’s skin…”
  • ✓Film Before & After on the same area, with the same lighting and angle.
  • ✓Use the product for at least 5 days before posting, and share your honest experience over time (Day 1 → Week 1).
  • ✓Show the product label and cream texture clearly.
  • ✓Respect your child’s privacy and comfort while filming.

DON’T

  • ✕Say MLE Cream “cures,” “treats,” “heals,” or “gets rid of” eczema.
  • ✕Use medical terms such as “medicine,” “prescription-strength,” “anti-inflammatory,” or “clinically proven to cure.”
  • ✕Promise guaranteed or instant results (“100% clear in 3 days,” “works for everyone”).
  • ✕Present it as a replacement for medicine, steroids, or a doctor’s care.
  • ✕Change or exaggerate the clinical numbers, or present them as your own results.
  • ✕Use filters or edits that change how the skin looks.
  • ✕Compare with or criticize other brands by name.
